mostWorthwhile.text: Adding oxygen to the red blood cells was most worthwhile because the result explained both binding and release, connecting the blood sample to the needs of working tissues.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making plasma was straightforward, but its result added little explanation beyond showing water and solutes together.

surprise.text: The explanation that more oxygen can leave haemoglobin where dissolved oxygen is low clarified how the carrier can supply working tissues.

arbitrary.text: Adding white cells and platelets made the sample more complete, but their roles were not explained, so their connection to the oxygen-carrying goal felt less clear.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to see how circulation brings oxygen-bearing blood close to the arm's cells. The chapter established that connection but did not yet show it.
